svg.title: Specialised cells
svg.desc: Two panels of simple drawings, each with the cell name in bold underneath and one or two short labels. Panel 1, animal cells in warm colours: red blood cell face-on and side-on, white blood cell wrapping round a germ, nerve cell with a long fibre in a fatty covering, muscle cell with stripes, ciliated cell under a layer of mucus with dust, and sperm cell with head, middle piece and tail. Panel 2, plant cells in green colours: root hair cell between soil particles, palisade cell full of chloroplasts, a pair of guard cells round an open stoma, xylem vessel with thick rings, and phloem sieve tube with a sieve plate and companion cell. Note: cells not drawn to the same scale.
svg.text: Cells not drawn to the same scale
